name: ADEME DPE
description: Official French energy-performance certificates for existing homes since July 2021. Search the open ADEME dataset for DPE ratings, addresses, building characteristics, heating systems, estimated consumption, emissions, and geocoding. Updated weekly; property-level data does not include owner identity.

tools.name: get_dataset_metadata
tools.description: Get current ADEME metadata and the full field schema for the existing-home DPE dataset. Use this before constructing advanced qs filters or select lists.

tools.name: search_dpes
tools.description: Search existing-home DPE records. For F/G retrofit leads, use a Data Fair/Lucene qs expression such as `etiquette_dpe:(F OR G)` and combine it with address, commune, postal-code, date, or geospatial constraints. Results can contain multiple DPEs for the same property; use numero_dpe and dates when deduplicating.

q.description: Simple full-text query across searchable fields.

qs.description: Advanced Data Fair/Lucene query, for example `etiquette_dpe:(F OR G) AND code_postal_ban:69003`.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return, for example `numero_dpe,etiquette_dpe,adresse_ban,code_postal_ban,nom_commune_ban,date_etablissement_dpe`.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's next URL.

format.description: Response format; JSON is the normal agent-friendly choice.

tools.name: list_field_values
tools.description: List distinct values and counts for a DPE field, optionally narrowed by a query. Useful for discovering valid ratings, municipalities, heating types, or property categories before a search.

field.description: Dataset field, for example etiquette_dpe, nom_commune_ban, type_batiment, or type_energie_n1.

q.description: Optional text query applied before aggregation.

qs.description: Optional advanced query applied before aggregation.
